threat_event: Card and patron data skimmed from the hosted checkout through a tenant-added tag or a script vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Content security policy trusts the tag manager domain; tenant tags not inventoried, authorized, or monitored; script vendors never assessed
affected_asset_or_process: TVOP hosted checkout (all tenants: Live Venues, hotels packages, streaming, 1,150 clients)
likelihood_basis: EV-065 (content security policy allows the tag manager domain; inventory lists platform scripts only); EV-049 (23 tags with no approval record); EV-033 (script vendors not on the provider list); EV-080 (group risk interviews)
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (Req. 6.4.3; 11.6.1); N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); N72-R04 (state breach laws)
existing_controls: Tokenization; hosted payment fields; WAF; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Block tenant tags in every checkout step; script inventory and authorization; tamper detection on all tenants' payment pages; assess script vendors

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and halts venues, hotels, and ticketing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, WAN, and cloud platform connect all divisions; flat hotel networks and acquired theaters outside EDR
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (shared hub; hotel front desks on flat staff networks); EV-050 (theaters outside EDR and the SIEM); EV-022 (immutable backups); EV-071 (failover test 2026-02-11)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups; TVOP disaster recovery tested twice in 2026
treatment_plan: Segment hotel networks; bring acquired theaters under EDR and the WAN; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: A shared incident misses a client, card brand, state, or SEC notice deadline

likelihood_basis: EV-026 (draft notification matrix, not exercised); EV-063 (client notice terms of 24 or 72 hours); EV-025 (no cross-division exercise)
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-role notification matrix (P08); client contract register; cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15
